data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 160.9m. The report narrates favourable prior year development emerged on the 2019 and 2020 years of account driven by favourable subrogation outcomes from the 2018 wildfires, partly offset by adverse development on the Cyber book. No explicit gross prior year reserve movement amount is provided; the gross claims development table (cumulative gross incurred claims) produces a net movement of approximately GBP 0.0m for underwriting years up to 2019 (flat). The Syndicate was materially impacted in 2021 by Hurricane Ida, the Texas Winter Storms and European floods with a combined net impact of GBP 33.0m.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable prior year development emerged on both the 2019 and 2020 years of account.
The Syndicate benefitted from favourable outcomes from subrogation on the 2018 wildfires, partly offset by adverse loss development on the Syndicate's Cyber book.
The net impact to the Syndicate of the claims incurred from these events was GBP 33.0m, or 20.6% on the combined ratio (2020: GBP 15.2m/12.4%).
The financial impact of COVID-19 on the Syndicate significantly reduced in 2021, with an overall net impact of GBP 3.6m or 2.2% of the combined ratio (2020: GBP 34.6m/28.1%).
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior year reserve movement amount is provided in the movement notes or narrative. 'Claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' in the Technical Account is a P&L line and was NOT used. Gross claims development triangle was used to compute prior year development (result ~ GBP 0.0m). Narrative text describes favourable PYD on 2019/2020 but does not quantify gross amounts; where the narrative references releases it may be reporting net (post-reinsurance) outcomes. Prior year movement therefore reported from triangle; confidence moderate.
